content.title: Dhurandhar 2: Release Date, Cast, Budget, Story and Trailer Details
content.text: The wait is finally over for one of the most anticipated cinematic events of the year; the release of Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge, the high-octane sequel to the 2025 blockbuster, is officially hitting theaters tomorrow, March 19, 2026, with paid previews already underway across major cities this evening.Directed by Aditya Dhar and produced by Jio Studios and B62 Studios, the film is being largely appreciated as a potential game-changer for Indian cinema, with trade analysts predicting a historic Rs 100+ crore opening day worldwide.Check out Dhurandhar 2 Release Live UpdatesThe Story: A Mission Beyond BordersThe sequel picks up directly from the gripping finale of the first installment. Ranveer Singh returns as Jaskirat Singh Rangi, a Punjab Regiment soldier-turned-spy known by his nickname Hamza.The narrative shifts to the gritty underworld of Karachi, where Hamza navigates a complex web of terror funding and intelligence warfare. Tasked with dismantling the terror networks responsible for the 26/11 attacks, Hamza must face off against the formidable Major Iqbal (played by Arjun Rampal) while navigating a city on the brink of a gang war between Baloch and Pathan factions.Also read: Dhurandhar 2 paid preview reactions: ‘Masterpiece’ to ‘exhausting’, what people are saying about Ranveer Singh starrer movieDhurandhar 2 CastRanveer Singh as Hamza Ali Mazari / Jaskirat Singh Rangi Sanjay Dutt as the rugged SP Chaudhary Aslam R. Madhavan as Ajay Sanyal, Director of IBArjun Rampal as the chilling antagonist Major IqbalSara Arjun as Yalina JamaliAkshaye Khanna appearing in a pivotal flashback as Rehman DakaitDhurandhar Part 2: Budget and Production ScaleMounted on a massive scale, the combined budget for the Dhurandhar saga is estimated between Rs 300 crore and Rs 475 crore. The sequel alone is reported to have cost upwards of Rs 250 crore, making it one of the most expensive Hindi films ever produced.A significant portion of the budget has been invested in high-end VFX and authentic location shoots to recreate the tense atmosphere of Karachi. The film has already secured a massive Rs 245 crore through non-theatrical rights (Digital, Satellite, and Music), meaning it enters the box office race in a very healthy financial position.Also read: Dhurandhar 2 mystery: Who is ‘Bade Sahab’? Aditya Dhar appeals fans not to spoil itDhurandhar 2: Trailer & RuntimeThe official trailer, released on March 7, sent shockwaves through social media, showcasing gravity-defying stunts and intense dialogue exchanges.Audiences should prepare for an epic sitting: the CBFC has cleared the film with an 'A' (Adults Only) certificate and a finalized runtime of 3 hours and 49 minutes (229 minutes), making it one of the longest action thrillers in recent memory.
